view.hello_pm: Tell the PM what you want to build — it plans the work and puts it on the board, and equipe hands each ticket to its owner. Tab or @name talks to anyone directly; Ctrl-B shows the board.
view.hello_pm_thread: The PM's conversation about {project} — its own, apart from the other projects' and the whole squad's. Write to start it; the PM knows the board and what the squad remembers. Ctrl-P picks another project.

view.help_click_drag: a line on the left opens it · a ticket number opens it on the board · drag over text to copy it · drag the list's edge to resize it

view.help_ctrl_p: pick a project — the list, the board and new work follow · Enter takes the next, typing finds one
view.help_ctrl_v: attach the clipboard's image — or drop an image file on the terminal
view.help_ctrl_w: with nothing typed: watch the member's browser live, above its conversation · again to stop
view.help_enter: send to the PM — or, with a ticket open, to the member on it, read at its next step
view.help_esc: stop a member mid-turn; what it hasn't read goes in at once
view.help_intro: The PM is your one conversation: tell it what you want — it answers what's quick and puts the rest on tickets, which equipe hands to their owners. On the left: the PM, then Inbox · In progress · All work, then the team. On the board: a yes · A how · r in words · n no · d changes · c talk. A project chip in the header, or /project <name>, filters to one.
view.help_leave: Ctrl-C twice leaves — the squad keeps working in the background.
view.help_modes: MODES — how much members do on their own · /mode [member] <mode>
view.help_on_board: a accept · r ask for changes · d the diff · Enter talk to its owner
view.help_scroll: scroll · End for the latest · Ctrl-O unfolds steps
view.help_ssh_paste: over SSH: your Mac's screenshot (once `equipe paste-setup` ran there)
view.help_suggestion: take the greyed suggestion in an empty composer
view.help_tab: with words typed to a member at work: a memo, read when its turn ends
view.help_walk: walk the list on the left: the PM, the tickets, the team
view.help_yan: allow · always allow · decline a request

view.hint_waiting: once done, a on the board or /resume T-{id}
view.mode_hint: /mode {member} full stops {member} asking · /mode for all modes
